name: LastPass
description: LastPass is a password manager and digital vault that stores and autofills login credentials, using zero-knowledge encryption so LastPass itself cannot access users' stored passwords.
best_for: The vendor targets individuals, families (up to 6 members), small teams/startups, small-to-medium businesses, enterprises, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).
features: Single sign-on (SSO) and MFA for business tiers

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: A unified access-management vault covering credentials, secrets, and privileged access for humans and machines.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations needing broader access governance beyond consumer password management.

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: An open-source, end-to-end encrypted password manager with self-hosting options.
alternatives.best_for: Users and businesses that want transparency (open source) and deployment flexibility.
